install_steps: Download rbac-tool for your platform from https://github.com/alcideio/rbac-tool/releases and move it to PATH
Or as a kubectl plugin: kubectl krew install rbac-tool (invoked as kubectl rbac-tool)
note: Runs against the current kubeconfig context. 'who-can' answers effective-permission questions across Roles/ClusterRoles/Groups, and 'gen' can synthesize least-privilege policies from observed audit traffic.
